items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: At this point I’m living with my older sister, Ada and Sy, on 2913 Lawton

ctx.x: I think that was on the other tape, so do that story.

In 1935, we – I was with an organization. At this point I’m living with my older sister, Ada and Sy, on 2913 Lawton, and the Tom Powell Drum and Bugle Corps convened on Vandervan and Finney, which is 3900 West and about 10 blocks the other way, so I had to walk 20 or so blocks to this rehearsal for the Tom Powell Drum and Bugle Corps, and I was assigned a bugle. So at least – I don’t have valves at this point, but at least I’ve got all the manipulation, articulation, and the embouchure functions down perfect.…
